name: The nine vehicles (theg pa rim pa dgu)

stages.name: śrāvakayāna
stages.description: Renunciation, ethics and insight into selflessness of the person; nirvāṇa as arhatship.

stages.name: pratyekabuddhayāna
stages.description: Realization of dependent origination; selflessness of the person and part of phenomena.

stages.name: bodhisattvayāna
stages.description: Bodhicitta, the six perfections, the two selflessnesses; the five paths and ten grounds.

stages.name: kriyātantra
stages.description: Outer tantra: purity, ritual and the deity seen as lord and servant.

stages.name: ubhayatantra / caryātantra
stages.description: Outer tantra: the deity as friend; view of yoga, conduct of kriyā.

stages.name: yogatantra
stages.description: Outer tantra: union with the deity in meditation.

stages.name: mahāyoga
stages.description: Inner tantra: generation stage; great purity and equality.

stages.name: anuyoga
stages.description: Inner tantra: completion stage; union of expanse and wisdom.

stages.name: atiyoga
stages.description: Awareness itself: cutting through and direct crossing.

notes: The nine vehicles are a doxographical hierarchy (each vehicle a complete path for its practitioners) rather than successive stages of one person's progress; interpretive bands are therefore not assigned.

name: The four vidyādhara levels of Mahāyoga

stages.name: rnam smin rig 'dzin
stages.description: The mind matured as the deity while the body is not yet transformed.

stages.name: tshe dbang rig 'dzin
stages.description: The body transformed into a vajra body free of birth and death.

stages.name: phyag chen rig 'dzin
stages.description: Arising in the deity's form of union on the path of meditation.

stages.name: lhun grub rig 'dzin
stages.description: The final fruit, equal to buddhahood.

notes: Correspondence to the five paths and the bands is the unit's low-confidence reconstruction.

name: The preliminaries according to the Words of My Perfect Teacher

stages.name: how to listen
stages.description: Avoiding the three defects and six stains; vast and skilful attitudes.

stages.name: dal 'byor
stages.description: Rarity of the precious human life.

stages.name: mi rtag pa
stages.description: Death certain, time uncertain.

stages.name: 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs
stages.description: Suffering of the six realms.

stages.name: las rgyu 'bras
stages.description: Ten virtues and non-virtues.

stages.name: thar pa'i phan yon
stages.description: Aspiration to liberation.

stages.name: bshes gnyen bsten tshul
stages.description: Examining, following and emulating the teacher.

stages.name: skyabs 'gro
stages.description: Refuge with prostrations.

stages.name: sems bskyed
stages.description: Aspiring and applying bodhicitta.

stages.name: rdor sems
stages.description: Purification with the four powers.

stages.name: maNDal
stages.description: Accumulation of merit and wisdom.

stages.name: ku sA li
stages.description: Cutting attachment to the body.

stages.name: bla ma'i rnal 'byor
stages.description: Blessing, the four empowerments, mingling minds.

stages.name: 'pho ba
stages.description: Preparation for death (restricted).

name: The path of the Yeshe Lama (Longchen Nyingthig Dzogchen)

stages.name: sngon 'gro
stages.description: As in pth:kunzang-lamai-shelung-ngondro.

stages.name: ru shan
stages.description: Outer, inner and secret rushen distinguishing mind and awareness.

stages.name: ngo sprod
stages.description: Recognition of awareness pointed out by the master.

stages.name: khregs chod
stages.description: Resting in primordially pure awareness; self-liberation.

stages.name: thod rgal
stages.description: The four visions of spontaneous presence.

stages.name: chos nyid zad pa
stages.description: Final fruit.

stages.name: bar do
stages.gloss: bardo instructions (for those not liberated in life)
stages.description: Recognition at death, in dharmatā or in becoming.

notes: Structure reconstructed from memory at section level.

name: The nine ways of Bön

stages.name: phywa gshen theg pa
stages.description: Divination, astrology, diagnosis.

stages.name: snang gshen theg pa
stages.description: Rites to the gods; ransom and exorcism.

stages.name: 'phrul gshen theg pa
stages.description: Rites to overcome harmful forces.

stages.name: srid gshen theg pa
stages.description: Funeral and after-death rites.

stages.name: dge bsnyen theg pa
stages.description: Ten virtues and lay vows.

stages.name: drang srong theg pa
stages.description: Monastic discipline.

stages.name: a dkar theg pa
stages.description: Tantra: generation of deities.

stages.name: ye gshen theg pa
stages.description: Higher tantra, the guru and consort practices.

stages.name: bla med theg pa
stages.description: The Great Perfection.

notes: Optional (Bön). Doxographical ordering (Southern Treasure); bands not assigned.
